description:
Makes this domain the one the account's emails are sent from by default, and clears the
flag on the domain that had it, so the account always has at most one default.

- **Repeatable:** it states the desired default rather than performing a change, so
  repeating the call on the domain that already is the default returns the same `200`.
- **Any status:** a domain can be the default while it is still `PENDING` or `FAILED`.
  Emails only leave from it once it is `VERIFIED`; until then they go out from BeeL.
- **Without the add-on:** it works, so an account can still choose among the domains it holds.
- **Credentials:** it changes the real account, so it requires a live API key or a dashboard
  session. A test API key answers `403 LIVE_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED`. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a
  retry does not repeat the operation.

BeeL API endpoint: PUT /v1/accounts/{account_id}/email-domains/{email_domain_id}/default (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

account_id.description: Your own account, or an account you provisioned. The account in the path, not the credential, decides which account the operation acts on. A `403` is returned when you do not reach it, the same response an account that does not exist gets.

name: beel_set_email_domain_default
